stem:
Humans depend upon food that comes from the ocean. Some human activities negatively impact these food supplies.

Which statement provides the best evidence that human activities contribute to this impact?

options.label: F
options.text: Human visitors to coral reef systems break corals growing on rocks.

options.label: G
options.text: Humans catch marine fish at a faster rate than the fish are able to reproduce.

options.label: H
options.text: Humans raise fish in a hatchery for commercial sale.

options.label: J
options.text: Humans construct artificial reefs to attract tourists.

visual_elements: Text of the question with answer choices F, G, H, J.
